integrity: Theorem, hypotheses, analytical proof and reproducibility code are supplied; no experimental output is represented as an infinite proof. Scientific priority remains subject to independent comparison.
scientific_limitations: Finite-state primitive correspondence with forbidden (0,0) edge, positive edge weight and quadratic correlation interaction only. Exact global diagram and explicit joint tricritical asymptotics are proved analytically; finite checker tests are diagnostic rather than an exhaustive proof. Equivalent older statistical-mechanics presentations cannot be excluded.
title: Tricritical crossover and exact first-order coexistence in an edge-weighted forbidden-transition correspondence
